Lead 2026-10-04 (S2.8 review):
- The appearance preference is System | Light | Dark, saved only when the user explicitly chooses an appearance (SetAppearance), never from model changes, opening a project, undo, or the initial listen.
- System makes every window follow the platform.
- Light or Dark is the default theme for NEW projects. An opened project keeps its own document theme.
- Saves are serialised, latest wins, and a failed save is retried on the next change.
